business_problem: Aviva wanted to make life insurance quoting and application initiation faster and easier for customers through an emerging LLM-based channel, while extending the digital distribution approach it had already launched for home insurance.
solution_summary: Aviva expanded its customer-facing ChatGPT app so users can start a life insurance journey conversationally instead of beginning on a conventional quote form. In the implementation described, customers enter their details into the ChatGPT app, which uses Aviva's collaboration with OpenAI and large language models to support the quote interaction. The resulting information is then passed into Aviva's existing quote journey with customer details pre-populated, reducing re-entry before the user moves into the insurer's owned transaction flow. The Aviva website acts as the downstream application and purchase system for customers who decide to proceed with cover. Aviva also says it will monitor how customers engage with the app to generate insight for future development across protection products and distribution channels, although the source does not name separate storage, orchestration, or analytics products.
